name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-fryguy
title: Redrawn Styled Fryguy
description:
Redrawn-style graphics for Sonikku's SMB2 Fryguy custom sprite, meant to be an amalgam between his official artwork and Super Mario All-Stars/Super Mario Advance in-game design.

It comes with 2 different type of variations for his fire projectiles.

Credit's not necessary but appreciated regardless.
